title: PLAT-103-1: validateApp rejects apps without owner (breaking, shared-contracts 2.0.0)
Extra: sub-route-reports also calls validateApp; pass owner (insights)

summary: PLAT-103 shipped in PR #1 (merged to main cbb44a18, CI and CD green). validateApp now throws when app.owner is missing or empty; shared-contracts bumped to 2.0.0 (breaking). core-shell (platform), billing (payments) and sub-route-reports (insights) pass owner from package.json team. Assumptions: (1) reports also calls validateApp and would have failed at startup, so I added owner: insights although the ticket did not list it; (2) owner is hardcoded to match package.json team, since build.js only inlines named imports and cannot read JSON; (3) all three sub-tasks shipped in one PR per CONTRIBUTING, since the lib is inlined at build time; (4) the 2.0.0 bump is advisory, because the in-repo lib is not published to the registry.
